purpose: Independent re-execution of load-bearing claims by the orchestrating lane, on a host other than the one that produced them, recorded with scope so the verification has a stated shelf life instead of living only in a conversation.
method: git archive <branch> <package> | tar -x on the host; run every non-test .py under python3 -I -B and the test file under -I -O -B; read the regenerated RESULT_V1.json fields directly. No package file edited.
